# Workspace Validation Checklist
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Next action: resolve every failed check before routing a matic issue to implementation.

## Structure

- [ ] `workspace/AGENTS.md` contains workspace-wide behavior and preserves the existing build pipeline.
- [ ] `workspace/CONTEXT.md` routes normal build work and matic work.
- [ ] `workspace/workflows/matic/CONTEXT.md` routes selection, resume, publish, review, and close operations.
- [ ] `workspace/stages/01-define` through `workspace/stages/05-learn` remain present.
- [ ] Stable rules are in `workspace/_config/` or `workspace/references/`.
- [ ] Run artifacts are under `application/runs/`.

## Stage Interfaces

- [ ] Every matic stage declares Inputs -> One Transformation -> Outputs.
- [ ] Existing Define, Design, Build, Measure, and Learn stages declare their interfaces.
- [ ] Every required input and output path is named.
- [ ] Downstream consumers explicitly name upstream outputs.
- [ ] No stage depends on hidden state or writes undeclared outputs.
- [ ] Blocked, paused, review, and merge-waiting states name a resume stage.

## Context Discipline

- [ ] No route requires loading the full repository by default.
- [ ] Issue selection loads only candidate issue, PR, label, and active-run information.
- [ ] Build stages load only the declared project and source context.
- [ ] Missing or invalid inputs cause a stop rather than an assumption.

## Matic Flow

- [ ] Only open issues with `matic` are eligible.
- [ ] Multiple candidates are scored by the configured simplicity criteria.
- [ ] A tie is resolved by issue number.
- [ ] A selected issue receives an execution plan before implementation.
- [ ] Relevant PM Control records are updated before Build.
- [ ] Existing Define and Design stages remain in the execution path unless their contracts prove they are not applicable.
- [ ] Reconciliation occurs before Measure and covers affected carriers.
- [ ] Measure is a hard gate before publication.
- [ ] The PR targets `staging` and requests `dennisatssd`.
- [ ] Issue closure requires verified merge of the exact recorded PR into `staging`.
- [ ] No PR auto-close keyword is used for a PR targeting `staging`.

## Quality And Recovery

- [ ] The threshold is 80% and the score formula is defined.
- [ ] Every applicable acceptance criterion must pass.
- [ ] Quality findings route to a concrete production stage.
- [ ] `run-state.md` records blocked, paused, review, merge, and completion state.
- [ ] Learn runs only after a passed Measure gate.
- [ ] A matic run cannot publish known-invalid output.

## Path And Security Checks

- [ ] No required workspace contract uses the obsolete `projects/lead-lab/` path.
- [ ] No required workspace contract uses the absent `_core/` path.
- [ ] Canonical source is `application/source/`.
- [ ] Current controls are `pm-control/registers/`.
- [ ] Production credentials and participant data are excluded.
